title: Barcelona paella and sangria experience
text:
Friendly host. It was in an area that was not really easy to get a taxi afterwards in an industrial area. We had to walk about 10 minutes before we could find a taxi location. 
Experience itself was enjoyable. There were only 7 of us and it was very interactive. We learned the skills behind making paella and we also made red homemade sangria. Afterwards we all dined together and shared conversation. 
Really nice experience, however Viator needs to be more transparent and communicating transportation as safety is a priority on an unfamiliar location.
author: Holly_L

title: Had a great learning and...
text: Had a great learning and cooking experience with the INVISIBLE CHEF! Loved how we could get to know other tourists and share this experience together. 10/10!
author: Ana_S

title: Everything and More
text:
What an amazing experience!  Where to start?  

The rooftop location was amazing. Not only beautiful, it felt like you were at a friend's party.  Not too fancy, not too casual, not touristy. Rather, a genuine experience of Barcelona, the culture. 

The lesson on making (and eating) the paella was approachable, unhurried, and made what might seem like a complicated dish accessible. 

But truly, the best part was the host himself. Benjamin is a fantastic host. Yes, as a teacher, he was very informative of the history of paella, the ingredients by region, and the key points for making the dish su
author: meganpollock76

title: Yummy
text: Lovely evening making delicious sangria and paella ! The teacher was fun and gave a history of paella making. Would recommend !
author: susan_C

title: Benjamin was so kind, and...
text: Benjamin was so kind, and both his knowledge and personality made this experience really special. He was accommodating to the other group members with allergy restrictions and overall just an incredible host. Highly recommend.
author: Johanna_A

title: Great cooking class!
text: Benjamin was very friendly, personable, and knowledgeable. His English was very good so we had no trouble communicating. The location was on a narrow one way street in an industrial residential area with minimal signage. Luckily our taxi driver ensured we were in the right place before leaving but you may have difficulty if you're arriving on your own. You do have to go up 3 flights of stairs to get to the rooftop and there is no elevator option. Our entire group enjoyed the experience and would love to do another class with him!
author: O5357XAnancyh

title: Amazing and Fun !
text: Benjamin was the ultimate host and chef. Loved everything about this Rooftop Spot in Barcelona. The care and quality of his style and cooking is above and beyond the norm. I We will go back and visit when here again as he is a wonderful host and chef !!!
author: Curiosity259626

title: Our chef Patrick gave us...
text: Our chef Patrick gave us a  Michelin experience. Patrick made sure all the people participated. He was thorough in his explanation of what ingredients were being used and how he was having us prepare it would highly recommend this cooking class to anyone
author: Gregory_B

title: A fantastic experience!
text: While the location felt a bit off the beaten track, the experience was fantastic! Our host Cesare was kind, patient and lots of fun. Beautiful fresh ingredients, lovely delicious food and Sangria. Great facilities. Super good value.
author: Kirsten_H

title: A great evening
text:
First, don’t let the meeting place throw you off. It’s on a non-descript street/alley with a blue door. The cooking was lots of fun with lots of information on the how and why of making traditional Paella as well as how others regions make it. Hands on for the whole group. Sangria was great!  Plan on it going closer to three hours and two, so you can relax and joy. 
Benjamin was a great instructor!
